Instructions for Use
Device description: The Lumen Cochlear Implant is a cochlear implant. It is available in lengths from 12 mm to 28 mm.
Warnings: For single use only. Do not resterilize. Store at 15 °C to 30 °C.
Refer to the surgical technique guide for implantation instructions.

Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) Safety Information
MR Conditional (3 Tesla or less): spatial field gradient ≤ 1900 gauss/cm (19 T/m); maximum B1+rms of 1 µT; Whole-Body SAR ≤ 0.1 W/kg; Normal Operating Mode.
